answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Each submission hangs on the comet of a task receipt, and the quartz is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ledge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
